findings.claim: The plan includes a large entity-graph/TanStack Query migration that is not required by any stated branding goal.
findings.evidence: Goals cover KnowMe brand adoption, tokens, typography, logos/product naming, surface restyling, token-based shadcn/assistant-ui theming, and visual/WCAG verification; none mention replacing TanStack Query or adopting Prometheus entity graph. The plan nevertheless adds change 3: "entity-graph-data-layer: Replace TanStack Query with the Prometheus entity graph" and acknowledges this is "infrastructure, not branding".
findings.suggested_fix: Move the entity-graph migration to a separate phase or add an explicit goal/assessment dependency showing why it must block the rebrand.

findings.claim: The product-naming acceptance criteria omit files the plan itself says must be changed, so residual Charcoal/Lovable branding can pass the change.
findings.evidence: Change 7 details include "set Tauri `productName`/window title \"KnowMe\"", "Update index.html", "Rewrite README", and "update CLAUDE.md \"Charcoal Agent\" wording", but its acceptance only greps `src index.html public README.md`: `grep -rni "charcoal" src index.html public README.md` and does not check `src-tauri`, `package.json`, `CLAUDE.md`, or other root metadata. The goal requires replacing "product naming with official KnowMe marks".
findings.suggested_fix: Expand acceptance checks to include `src-tauri`, `package.json`, `CLAUDE.md`, root config/metadata, and any desktop/window-title files touched by the change.

findings.claim: The chat restyling change uses brand identity assets but does not declare a dependency on the identity change.
findings.evidence: Change 9 `chat-surfaces-flat2` says "welcome state uses the KnowMe mark instead of SparklesIcon", while Change 7 `knowme-brand-identity` is the change that creates "new Logo/Wordmark components" and ports `KnowMeLogo` / `KnowMeWordmark`; Change 9 depends only on `assistant-ui-latest, knowme-brand-tokens`.
findings.suggested_fix: Add `knowme-brand-identity` as an explicit dependency of `chat-surfaces-flat2`.
